annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/459 of 1 February 2024 on setting up the European Digital Infrastructure Consortium for Networked Local Digital Twins towards the CitiVERSE (LDT CitiVERSE EDIC)
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/459 of 1 February 2024 on setting up the European Digital Infrastructure Consortium for Networked Local Digital Twins towards the CitiVERSE (LDT CitiVERSE EDIC)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision setting up the LDT CitiVERSE EDIC, a European Digital Infrastructure Consortium for networked local digital twins, seated in Valencia. It grants legal personality and annexes key statute elements (duration, winding up, liability, VAT/excise exemptions). AI is mentioned only as a driver of digital twins.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets up the LDT CitiVERSE EDIC with legal personality in all Member States
Statutory seat in Valencia, Spain; indefinite duration
Members' liability limited to their contributions; EU not liable for debts
VAT and excise exemptions limited to non-economic official purchases above EUR 300
Based on Digital Decade Policy Programme 2030 Decision (EU) 2022/2481
